headline: Santander Follows Peers in Raising Mortgage Rates in Brazil
summary: Santander raised its minimum mortgage rates in Brazil, following similar increases by Itaú and Bradesco, with rates moving above the SFH housing finance ceiling.
why: Higher mortgage interest rates reflect tightening credit conditions and rising funding costs across the commercial banking sector, which can cool housing demand.

impacts.name: Banking & Real Estate
impacts.why: Higher borrowing costs across major private banks tend to suppress residential property transaction volumes.
